description: R.L. Nilgiriya and Another v. Gamini De Soysa and Others R.L. Nilgiriya and Another v. Gamini De Soysa and Others View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: R.L. Nilgiriya and Another v. Gamini De Soysa and Others R.L. Nilgiriya and Another v. Gamini De Soysa and Others View More
keywords: The District Court Judge had set aside an abatement order and allowed substitution of heirs after the death of the 1st plaintiff in a property action. Held - abatement cannot be ordered ex mero motu (on the court’s own motion) under Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code without notice to the parties. Leave to Appeal refused with costs as sufficient cause for delay had been established and substitution was proper.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
